payload.title: Preserve frozen feedback watermark through portfolio launch
payload.description:
An automatically selected target can be ready for optimization yet fail immediately before dispatch because its frozen assessment provenance does not expose the feedback watermark required by the stale-evidence gate.

Feature: Frozen portfolio evidence reaches optimizer launch
  Scenario: Launch a selected target with unchanged feedback evidence
    Given exhaustive ranking captured a complete feedback watermark
    And assessment selected the target as ready to optimize
    And live champion, feedback, cooldown, configuration, and packet evidence are unchanged
    When the portfolio coordinator validates the target for launch
    Then the exact frozen feedback watermark is available to the launch gate
    And the target is accepted for one idempotent child dispatch

  Scenario: Reject genuinely changed feedback evidence
    Given a selected target carries its frozen feedback watermark
    When the live feedback watermark differs before launch
    Then the target is rejected as stale
    And no child optimization procedure is created
